alternate_format_policy_note: When a downloadable file is not the safest accessible route, keep a current accessible HTML summary or other official alternate-format/help path visible.
delivery_role_note: Download links and embedded viewers help the public retrieve current official voter-information files, but the handoff layer does not become the rule source by itself.
edition_parity_policy_note: Wrapper pages, embedded viewers, and downloadable files stay aligned on the controlling edition/state. Superseded files are clearly marked, withdrawn, or routed through an explicit superseding notice.
file_delivery_surface_label: Example State official voter-information file-delivery surface
file_type_disclosure_policy_note: Non-HTML handoffs identify file type and expected behavior before or at handoff. Where practical, the file size or similar context is shown too.
html_primary_policy_note: When HTML can safely carry the public answer, keep it current and use files as printable or retained companions rather than the only route to action-changing guidance.
privacy_minimization_note: Avoid retaining per-user download or viewer telemetry longer than the published policy requires. Do not bind public file-open behavior to voter records without a separately disclosed authority.
viewer_boundary_policy_note: Embedded viewers keep the file edition/scope visible, preserve a direct download option, and keep the current official page/help path recoverable if the viewer fails or is unsupported.
